summary.title: Giselle (character)
summary.name: Giselle
summary.excerpt: Giselle is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She serves as the guide in charge of handling the Guild System in the world of Orebus. She is also one of the discoverers of the world of Orebus.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Giselle is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She serves as the guide in charge of handling the Guild System in the world of Orebus. She is also one of the discoverers of the world of Orebus.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: Giselle appears upon joining a guild for the first time.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content: Upon joining a guild, Noel teleports the Summoner to Orebus, a world found by Noel and Giselle in a dimensional fracture in the Vortex. Giselle introduces herself to the Summoner along with information regarding the world of Orebus and the Guild System.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: Giselle is shown to be quite cheerful, outgoing, and informative. She also holds a fair amount of knowledge regarding the world of Orebus and its origins.

sections.title: Noel
sections.content: Both Noel and Giselle found the world of Orebus while surveying the Vortex. Giselle also has the tendency to tease Noel even when not present alongside him, as shown when the Summoner is introduced to the Guild System.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Giselle appears in the Guild Board and notifies the guild whenever a new member joins the guild or the guild levels up (Guild Level, Zel Boost, Karma Boost, etc).
- Giselle is currently the only character of the Akras Summoners' Hall that appears as an exclusive to Brave Frontier Global.
